integrity: The full primary source was checked at the explicit perturbation, normalization, Jacobian, fold equation, and source threshold argument. The new derivative inequality is reconstructed analytically from Poisson/Fourier representation and a one-constraint L-infinity extremal problem. The same source perturbation is proved to saturate the inequality for every radius. Symbolic replay verifies the kernel algebra, sharp integral, source derivative, and threshold factorization.
scientific_limitations: The result proves sharp transverse-derivative control and optimality only for bounded real vertical shears with zero first jet, and only for the first fold on the positive real axis. It does not rule out other harmonic architectures or nonreal folds at smaller M. The displayed decimal threshold is numerical; the exact threshold is defined by the unique cubic root.
title: Sharp transverse derivative and optimality of the harmonic Landau shear
